#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Mutation harness for the poll-interval "cannot drift" claim (round 5 re-verify).
# Each mutation: fresh copy of the base module, one edit, run the drift tests,
# print the failing test names. Scratch only; never touches the tracked tree.
set -u
BASE=<repo>/.tmp/icr5-base
WORK=<repo>/.tmp/icr5-work
TESTS='TestPoller_SetInterval_Invalid|TestPoller_Start_InvalidPollIntervalNamesFullSet|TestPollIntervals_SortedAscending|TestPollDuration|TestValidPollInterval|TestSetPollInterval_InvalidErrorListsFullSet|TestSetPollInterval_AcceptsEveryValidInterval|TestSetPollIntervalTool_DescriptionsListFullSet|TestInboxDoc_ListsFullIntervalSet|TestReadmeDoc_ListsFullIntervalSet'

run() {
  local name="$1"; shift
  rm -rf "$WORK"
  cp -r "$BASE" "$WORK"
  ( cd "$WORK" && "$@" )
  local out
  out=$(cd "$WORK" && go test -count=1 -run "$TESTS" ./internal/email/ ./internal/mcp/ 2>&1)
  local failed
  failed=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^\s*--- FAIL: ' | sed -E 's/^\s*--- FAIL: ([^ ]+).*/\1/' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
  if [ -z "$failed" ]; then
    if printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'build failed\|cannot\|undefined'; then
      failed="BUILD-ERROR"
    else
      failed="(none — SURVIVED)"
    fi
  fi
  printf '%-48s -> %s\n' "$name" "$failed"
}

MAP=internal/email/config.go
INBOX=plugin/commands/inbox.md
README=README.md
TOOLS=internal/mcp/poll_tools.go

# --- the five from the previous pass ---
run "M1 map: add 20m" \
  sed -i 's|"30m": 30 \* time.Minute,|"20m": 20 * time.Minute,\n\t"30m": 30 * time.Minute,|' "$MAP"
run "M2 map: add 4m" \
  sed -i 's|"5m":  5 \* time.Minute,|"4m":  4 * time.Minute,\n\t"5m":  5 * time.Minute,|' "$MAP"
run "M3 map: remove 15m" \
  sed -i '/"15m": 15 \* time.Minute,/d' "$MAP"
run "M4 inbox cron: 10m -> */15 (wrong expr)" \
  sed -i 's|`10m` → `\*/10 \* \* \* \*`|`10m` → `*/15 * * * *`|' "$INBOX"
run "M5 inbox hint: drop 15m" \
  sed -i 's/| 15m | 30m |/| 30m |/' "$INBOX"

# --- new ones ---
run "M6 inbox cron: right expr, wrong key 12m" \
  sed -i 's|`10m` → `\*/10 \* \* \* \*`|`12m` → `*/10 * * * *`|' "$INBOX"
run "M7 inbox hint: duplicate 5m token" \
  sed -i 's/| 5m | 10m |/| 5m | 5m | 10m |/' "$INBOX"
run "M8 inbox hint: add 20m not in cron table" \
  sed -i 's/| 15m | 30m |/| 15m | 20m | 30m |/' "$INBOX"
run "M9 inbox cron: drop 15m row (hint intact)" \
  sed -i 's|`15m` → `\*/15 \* \* \* \*`,||' "$INBOX"
run "M10 inbox cron: extra 20m row" \
  sed -i 's|`15m` → `\*/15 \* \* \* \*`,|`15m` → `*/15 * * * *`, `20m` → `*/20 * * * *`,|' "$INBOX"
run "M11 inbox cron: duplicate 5m row in prose" \
  sed -i 's|^4. Report a single|   Also \`5m\` → \`*/5 * * * *\`.\n4. Report a single|' "$INBOX"
run "M12 inbox cron: 1h -> */60 (wrong hour shape)" \
  sed -i 's|`1h` → `0 \* \* \* \*`|`1h` → `*/60 * * * *`|' "$INBOX"
run "M13 inbox: separator → becomes ->" \
  sed -i 's/` → `/` -> `/g' "$INBOX"
run "M14 inbox frontmatter: allowed-tools before hint" \
  bash -c 'python3 - <<EOF
p="plugin/commands/inbox.md"; L=open(p).read().split("\n"); L[2],L[3]=L[3],L[2]; open(p,"w").write("\n".join(L))
EOF'
run "M15 map: add 90m (uncovered cron shape)" \
  sed -i 's|"1h":  time.Hour,|"90m": 90 * time.Minute,\n\t"1h":  time.Hour,|' "$MAP"
run "M16 map: add 45s (sub-minute)" \
  sed -i 's|"1m":  time.Minute,|"45s": 45 * time.Second,\n\t"1m":  time.Minute,|' "$MAP"
run "M17 map: 30m key -> 20min duration" \
  sed -i 's|"30m": 30 \* time.Minute,|"30m": 20 * time.Minute,|' "$MAP"
run "M18 README tool row: drop 15m" \
  sed -i '140s/, 15m//' "$README"
run "M19 README slash row: drop 5m (15m stays)" \
  sed -i '150s/ 5m,//' "$README"
run "M20 README tool row: drop 5m (15m stays)" \
  sed -i '140s/ 5m,//' "$README"
run "M21 README: add 20m to both rows" \
  sed -i -e '140s/15m, 30m/15m, 20m, 30m/' -e '150s/15m, 30m/15m, 20m, 30m/' "$README"
run "M22 README: 5m moved to the /inbox n row" \
  sed -i -e '150s/ 5m,//' -e '151s/polling\./polling (5m)./' "$README"
run "M23 poll_tools: hardcode desc list w/o 2m" \
  sed -i 's|intervals := email.PollIntervalList()|intervals := "1m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h"|' "$TOOLS"
run "M24 poll_tools: error text drops 3m" \
  sed -i 's|fmt.Sprintf("invalid interval %q: must be %s, or n", interval, email.PollIntervalList())|fmt.Sprintf("invalid interval %q: must be %s, or n", interval, "1m, 2m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h")|' "$TOOLS"
run "M25 poller: InvalidIntervalError lists 15m only" \
  sed -i 's|return "invalid poll interval " + e.Value + ": must be " + PollIntervalList() + ", or n"|return "invalid poll interval " + e.Value + ": must be 15m, or n"|' internal/email/poller.go

rm -rf "$WORK"

## Summary

Bead **beadle-1ljl**. The inbox poll-interval set had nothing between `1m` and `5m`, so the only way to poll an agent mailbox at least every three minutes was the one-minute floor. This adds `2m` and `3m`, and in doing so removes the reason the set drifted in the first place: it was hand-copied in nine places (two already stale on this branch before review caught them). Every in-binary string now derives from one exported, duration-sorted source in `internal/email`, and every test ranges over that source rather than pinning literals.

- `internal/email`: `2m`, `3m` in `validPollIntervals`; exported `PollIntervals()` / `PollIntervalList()`; both poller error strings built from it; doc comment no longer hand-lists the set.
- `internal/mcp`: tool description, parameter description, and invalid-interval error built from `email.PollIntervalList()`; tests range over `PollIntervals()` with set equality (element matching, not substring), the tools/list descriptions are asserted, and `plugin/commands/inbox.md` plus the two README rows are read and checked set-equal to the Go set with every cron row's expression derived from `time.ParseDuration`.
- `plugin/commands/inbox.md`: the set appears in exactly two places (argument hint, cron table); routing rule and heading point at the table.
- `README.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: full set listed; README example config uses `3m` instead of `30m`.
- Two pre-existing tests that used `3m` as the canonical invalid fixture now use `4m`.
- Mission exports for m-2026-10-22-014, -018, -019, -023, -027 (paths redacted); 014 closed failed at a write-set boundary that was a contract defect.

Poller first-poll suppression and its minimum interval are unchanged.

## Demo

Docs-only parts: `npx markdownlint-cli2` on README.md, CHANGELOG.md, DESIGN.md, plugin/commands/inbox.md reports zero issues. Mechanical parts verified through the real entry points:

```text

ok

#  15m cron row -> */5 * * * *        TestInboxDoc fails on the exact-row compare

$ set_poll_interval interval=bogus                     -> error names 1m, 2m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, or n
```

Operator confirmation: the rendered docs read correctly; the live `/inbox 3m` path creates a `*/3 * * * *` cron, which is confirmed by using it.

## Gate

`make check` green from the main checkout on the final head (lint, lint-strict, vulncheck, docs, full `-race` suite). Five mission rounds, evaluator (rsc) accept on each; code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, and invariant-completeness-reviewer each ran at least twice, the last pass mutation-tested the guards and drove rounds 4 and 5.
